Riley: Heads-up — NovaThera's invoice INV-7784 bounced today. Four card attempts declined with 'card_restricted' and ACH microdeposit verification timed out. Can we triage?
Jun: Which charge ids / cards?
Riley: ch_05TZXY... x4. Last4 3411 (Amex) and 5421 (MC). Gateway note = card_restricted, acquirer response 412.
Kasia: Finance: we'll permit alternate settlement via wire or virtual card. Waive late fee if cleared within 48h. Need remittance to mark paid.
Ivy: I can pause autopay retries for this merchant. Recommend stop further card attempts until we confirm BIN mapping.
Jun: Pausing retries now. Also I'll spin a temporary route to processor p-zeta at 10% to test.
PaymentsBot: autopay paused for novathera; routing p-zeta rollout 10% initiated.
Riley: Customer is doing payroll — they prefer a virtual card. Kasia, do we accept virtual-card settlements and how to tag invoice?
Kasia: Yes. Tag as 'settled-virtual' after auth trace + settlement confirmation. Attach proof to ticket.
Ivy: Created Zendesk ticket Z#12009 and messaged customer the options (wire + virtual).
ZendeskBot: Ticket Z#12009 created for NovaThera - payment failures.
Jun: Initial p-zeta attempts 0/2 accepted. Rolling back to 0% for now. Opening gateway case for acquirer code 412.
Riley: Commands I used to get logs: `curl "https://payments.redwood/internal/charges?invoice=INV-7784&status=failed" | jq .`
Kasia: Wire template (internal): Bank: US Bank; Account: Redwood Inference, Inc.; Acct: 444666111; ABA: 091000022; SWIFT: USBKUS44; Ref: NovaThera-INV-7784
Ivy: Noted. I've attached waiver note to Z#12009 and will add a hold on retries until gateway responds.
Jun: Gateway case GATE-4021 opened asking for BIN restrictions details and recommended MCC.
Riley: Customer replied, will attempt virtual card this afternoon and keep wire as backup.
Kasia: Finance ops standing by to reconcile. Once we have remittance or virtual auth trace, mark invoice accordingly and cancel retries.
PaymentsBot: Monitor set: escalate if >3 failed attempts within 8h for novathera.
Ivy: Follow-up actions: add BIN test to harness, mute aggressive retries on 'card_restricted', and post gateway findings when available.
Riley: Thanks team — closing loop once settlement confirmed. :thumbsup:
